match_rule: the grid rate whose step-10 rel_norm_max is closest to the SGD fine-tune's 0.00238 (|log ratio|); matched if within 15%. If none is, recorded 'unmatched' and the closest is still scored. Learned if its held-out P(o) at step 10 >= 0.9; if not, its verdicts are reported flagged 'did not learn'.
verdict: faith_score.verdict against the same-job W0 floor of each reading: PGD ratios against pgd_floor (pass <= 1.5/(1+f), fail >= 1.5(1+f), inconclusive between), stochastic against stochastic_floor.
